scope_gate: Material changes require a complete ChangeEnvelope. Unmentioned elements are preserved; deletion, contract break or expansion requires new Intent or explicit authority.
design_system_gate: Before implementing an interface, inspect the component catalog and record reuse, extend, create, local or not_applicable with rationale and consumers.
architecture_gate: Resolve the domain ArchitectureProfile and admit new complexity only for an observed problem with a simpler alternative assessment, owner, fitness function, lifecycle cost, rollback and removal condition.
context_gate: Compile the smallest sufficient authoritative dependency subgraph for the Intent, reject superseded unrelated history and record a ContextManifest.
model_routing: Select the least expensive allowlisted provider-model route that meets capability, risk, data and eval thresholds; declare ceilings before execution and reroute only with fresh evidence.
usage_accounting: Record provider usage per run when available, mark unavailable as unknown, estimate immediately and reconcile invoiced cost from the provider billing source.
automation_gate: New work is human-assisted by default; API automation requires a bounded repeatable capability, hard limits, evals, traceability and fallback.
quality_gate: All applicable mandatory scenarios require fresh passing evidence; waivers are scoped, compensating and expiring.
exposure_gate: The worst of people, operations, economic value and data exposure drives evolution while safety floors remain independent of volume.
forbidden_inferences: Stale evidence proves the current revision
Silence authorizes removal or behavior change
A nearby refactor belongs to the requested delta
Cheapest token price means cheapest validated outcome
